patch.value: Outcome milestone: multi-decade continuity — readable, migratable, privacy-governed proof across generations of formats and cryptography

Prove that a pm workspace remains understandable verifiable restorable and governable across decades of schema format cryptographic organizational and legal change. This milestone composes existing history attestation compatibility format migration retention and lawful-erasure work into a long-lived institutional-memory outcome.

A multi-decade synthetic corpus spanning every supported format and schema generation is readable queryable and independently verifiable by the public SDK; Every format cryptographic and schema migration is lossless resumable idempotent and represented by new immutable evidence rather than silent rewrite; Retention lawful erasure archival and proof-preserving redaction policies have executable conformance tests and explicit jurisdiction-neutral extension points; Cryptographic algorithm agility is declared in the proof format and at least one full algorithm migration is proven without invalidating prior attestations; Restoration at sampled versions across the complete supported window reproduces item workspace and relationship state byte-equivalently where the contract promises byte identity
Preserve trustworthy institutional context across generations of software organizations and policy
The tracker remains a durable source of truth rather than becoming an unreadable archive after format or cryptographic change
Connects immutable history portability compatibility migration retention and privacy into one evidence-gated continuity contract
A publicly specified and independently testable multi-decade continuity guarantee
Provable history ends at restoration under current contracts while already-tracked compatibility erasure and cryptographic agility work has no later portfolio outcome
